dct_description_sm: The Queen’s University Research Data Management Survey 2024 is the second RDM survey conducted by Queen's University Library and the Vice-Principal Research Portfolio. This survey was administered to monitor any changes in responses to the first survey and introduce new questions related to how respondents manage their research data during the active data phase of a research project.
